faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.answerOne: All recipes on this site focus on authentic, traditional preparation methods. I aim to preserve original culinary heritage rather than modified modern shortcuts.
faq.answerTwo: While you can replace ingredients based on local availability, sticking to the listed original items ensures the authentic taste and texture intended for the dish.
faq.questionThree: Are the yield and calories exact?
faq.answerThree: Nutrition information and serving sizes are estimated standard averages per portion to give you a helpful baseline for meal planning.
faq.questionFour: How often are new recipes added?
faq.answerFour: New classic recipes are tested, documented, and published regularly. Follow along on Instagram for updates.
faq.questionFive: Can I share or reuse these recipes?
faq.answerFive: Feel free to share links to the recipes. If you re-post photos or content on social media or blogs, please provide direct credit and a link back to BY ALÉ.
faq.questionSix: Who made this website and why?
faq.answerSix: This website was created by Sascha(@saschakobalt), special thanks to Eric(@erichastedt). The goal is to share traditional recipes and preserve culinary heritage. The website is currently under development(aka beta). No AI was used and will never be used.
